title: v1_113
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.113 _Release date: March 25, 2026_ --- Welcome to the 1.113 release of Visual Studio Code. This release includes various improvements across the **agent and developer experience**. * [**Chat customizations**](#chat-customizations-editor-preview): Manage all chat-related customizations from a single, unified interface. * [**Configurable thinking effort**](#configurable-thinking-effort-in-model-picker): Control a model's reasoning level directly from the UI. * [**Nested subagents**](#nested-subagents): Allow subagents to invoke other subagents for complex multi-step workflows. * [**CLI agent capabilities**](#agent-experience): Use MCP servers, fork sessions, and view debug logs in CLI agents. * [**Images preview**](#images-preview-for-chat-attachments): Preview images from chat with the full-featured image viewer. * [**Default themes refresh**](#new-default-themes): Enjoy a fresh new look with updated default light and dark themes. Happy Coding! --- VS Code is rolling out gradually to all users. Use **Check for Updates** in VS Code to get the latest version immediately. To try new features as soon as possible, [**download the nightly Insiders build**](https://code.visualstudio.com/insiders), which includes the latest updates as soon as they are available. ---
